reading_candidates: General psh limits need not have a Zariski-closed polar locus; stage FS polar formula only applies to stages.

Support/centre residue-field valuation needs values in R union infinity on affine charts; nonnegative near centre only. Proper-support centre proof must use valuation-ring morphisms, not inject local rings into residue fields.
Finite source normality is not needed for analytic openness when target normal, by normalization of source and surjective analytic lifts.
Valuation transitivity uses sigma inverse and must retain normalization of the real absolute value; purely inseparable radicial example cusp is not a counterexample, node is.
The finite-flat pushforward on N1 must be defined by the norm of a line bundle and proved numerically well defined using degrees over curves, not arbitrary cycle pushforward.
Nonflat cone class-group assertion applies to rank-one reflexive modules, not all finite rank-one modules; global module freeness and local flatness need distinguish.
Finite locally free affine modules are projective, not necessarily free on every affine chart; generic-field injection gives integral W without an unsupported connectedness claim.
Generic field norms exist on normal targets even without flatness. Nonflat cone norm of O1 extends to H: remove claimed local-class obstruction and claims of undefined norm bundle.
Polynomial laws can be evaluated in bases and determined by sufficiently rich point values; finite-Fp example does not make all closed-point checks invalid in every positive characteristic.
Completion and algebraic valued-field extensions are flat; residue-field base change need not be. Finite-type claims should allow trivial completions.
Rank-two three-field-regime example needs base A field. Norm line divisor proof using lengths needs normal Z and integral W for the given DVR argument, or a separate broader proof.

Norm exists globally independent of frames; full-preimage frames justify the local determinant formula. Under tau prime = unit tau, local coefficients multiply by norm(unit)^-1 and norm frame by norm(unit).
Frobenius norm is T0^p + xT1^p with no ambiguous sign. Trace u^i vanish by direct companion-matrix diagonal computation, not just charpolynomial of u.
Bz is not exceptionally reduced: it is reduced on etale locus; completed field extension may acquire nilpotents even at full support.
Fibre decomposition onto can use completed residue field Hw quotient of Bz tensor Hz directly, avoiding an unproved broad completion decomposition theorem.
Analytic weights can jump near generic trivial point, not across distinct P1 rays near a positive finite parameter. Total GF stages need no ordinary finite continuity claim at poles.
Norm factorization after algebraic closure uses Artinian composition filtration tensored with polynomial ring; Ki is a residue field, not a canonically embedded coefficient subfield of Ci.
Finite-average formula extends to arbitrary bounded-above extended-real functions, separately from its FS construction. Real subgroup scaling t may leave subgroup unless tLambda contained Lambda.
Presentation classes need not be intrinsic to functions; averaged classes may already equal target and finite corrections are not proved impossible.
Curve example log u expression is valid when centre is in finite affine chart; use global section system first, since rational function log u can be positive at infinity.
Main descent regularization line bundles have rational classes but real weights; invoke real-weight version of limit corollary explicitly.

Cone global norm computation must divide homogeneous coordinates by a local frame. Generic field equality does not by itself prove line-bundle isomorphism across exceptional divisor; compute norm of w divisor.
Drop Artin lengths use cubic proper-support weights 2,1: normalized point count gives 1/2 versus actual1/3. Frobenius generic trivial has field degree p and no Artin length p.
Drop carrier is a proof failure here, not a disproof of unconditional fibre-constant reflection; non-fibre-constant example cannot disprove fibre-constant descent.
Forbidden subtraction is undefined at common infinite values; finite-valued fibre averages are linear on arbitrary real functions, though differences need not be FS.
Only source EP is consumed in descent proof, but EP_X is conclusion; exact occurrence counts and novelty claims must be scoped or removed.

mathematical_repairs: Affine semivaluations may take negative finite values; nonnegativity concerns the centre local ring. Support and centre proofs use ring maps without injecting a local ring with nonzero support kernel into a field.

Analytic openness depends on normality of the target; normality of an integral source can be removed by finite normalization and analytic surjectivity. Conjugacy normalization and inverse automorphism are corrected.
Proper-support density is dimension-dependent; arbitrary psh polar sets need not be algebraic, and inseparable completed fibres may be nonreduced even at full support.

Nonflat finite maps to a normal target may admit a line-bundle norm. The cone fibre has dimension three versus generic degree two, which obstructs constant-rank determinant base change, not line-bundle existence.

Flatification integrality is established using the common dense generic field, without incorrectly inferring connectedness from faithful flatness. Locally free does not mean free on every affine chart.

Finite-flat norm induces a well-defined map on Cartier numerical classes by the determinant degree formula on normalized curves and their fundamental cycles. No unrestricted proper pushforward on N1 is claimed.

Norm divisor identity has integral source and normal target hypotheses, with DVR Smith-normal-form proof. Multiplicativity and arbitrary base change extend to rational tensor classes by clearing denominators.
Full-preimage frames use semilocal trivialization; changes multiply coefficients by inverse unit norm and norm frames by the unit norm.
Pure-inseparable universal norm is exactly T0^p+xT1^p. The residue factorization avoids assuming a coefficient-field inclusion, and determinant exponents follow from a composition filtration.
Weights retain complete residue-field degrees, Artin lengths and possible defect. Neither analytic-lift counts nor unweighted geometric counts replace them; scaling respects its weight subgroup.

Real-weight regularization, presentation classes and nontrivial limits are explicit. The maximum of the uncertified regularized family supremum is proved directly from its raw supremum and constant bound.

Curve coordinate formulas are restricted to centres in their finite charts. The cone norm line is globally identified by div Norm(w)=div(z), then the coefficient norm of u/w−1 is (z−a^2)/z; generic equality alone does not identify line bundles.

Subtraction at common poles is forbidden; averaged poles can arise at different lifts. Failure of a carrier hypothesis is a boundary of the available proof, not a disproof of stronger fibrewise descent.
EP source assumptions, target conclusions, supplied-source boundaries and external theorem locators are reconciled; unsupported novelty and exhaustive counts are removed.
